related.description: Robust, Ubiquitous and Massively Scalable Messaging Platform (XMPP, MQTT, SIP Server)
Free and Open Source messaging and emailing app that combines common web applications into one.
Open-source live-chat, email support, omni-channel desk. An alternative to Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud etc. 🔥💬
💬   Open source machine learning framework to automate text- and voice-based conversations: NLU, dialogue management, connect to Slack, Face...
